root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex="0", which places them in the browser's tab order. When the combobox dropdown is open, pressing Tab moves focus to the first suggestion item instead of the next form field (dietary).
repair_strategy: Remove the tabindex="0" attribute from the generated suggestion list items. The combobox pattern uses aria-activedescendant for keyboard navigation via arrow keys, so the items do not need to be in the tab order.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key now moves focus to the next form field (dietary) as expected, improving keyboard navigation order (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3). Screen readers can still access suggestions via aria-activedescendant and arrow keys.
functional_risks: Talkback screen reader might lose direct focus access to suggestions, but the ARIA combobox pattern does not require tabindex on options; they are accessed via aria-activedescendant.
verification_requirements: Run the provided journey test (Tab from city to dietary) and ensure it passes.
Run the regression guard (choose suggestion with arrow keys and Enter) and ensure it still passes.
Verify that the suggestion list items are not in the tab order when the dropdown is open.
